records.headline: Hurricane Lala lashes Hawaii’s Big Island
records.summary: Hawaii’s Big Island is experiencing heavy winds and rain as Category 1 Hurricane Lala approaches. A direct strike would mark Hawaii’s first hurricane landfall in more than 30 years. The National Hurricane Center is warning of life-threatening flash flooding and mudslides.

records.headline: Swarms of jellyfish take over one Maryland beach
records.summary: Swarms of jellyfish have filled the waters off Ocean City, Maryland, keeping some beachgoers on shore during peak summer season.

records.headline: Chess lessons from Woman Grandmaster Nemo
records.summary: Did you know about chess moves ‘en passant’ and ‘castling’? CNN’s Matias Grez receives a chess lesson from influencer and Woman Grandmaster Nemo.

records.headline: Russian e-commerce giant’s warehouse on fire
records.summary: Video geolocated by CNN shows a Wildberries warehouse on fire in Koledino, Moscow Oblast. Ukraine has been attacking warehouses of the e-commerce giant across Russia over the last month, according to Reuters.

records.headline: Mamdani's Mandarin impresses the internet
records.summary: People are reacting online to New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani speaking Mandarin in a video posted on social media. The video draws attention to a lottery his administration created, in partnership with the Theatre Development Fund, to give high school students free tickets to Broadway shows.

records.headline: Gov. Moore on Trump's comments about USS Abraham Lincoln: 'It pisses me off'
records.summary: Maryland Gov. Wes Moore joined CNN’s "State of the Union" and sharply criticized President Donald Trump’s handling of concerns involving deployed US service members, saying America’s military deserves missions that are clear, understandable and winnable.

records.headline: CNN first to see Ukraine’s empty Patriot launchers
records.summary: Russian ballistic attacks on Ukraine have surged as its stock of Patriot interceptor missiles almost runs dry. Nick Paton Walsh explains why the US-made system is so critical as he gets the first media access to Patriot launchers sitting in a quiet field with empty canisters.

records.headline: Braving one of Europe's tallest waterslides
records.summary: At Antalya’s Land of Legends theme park on the Turkish Riviera, CNN producer Leroy Ah Ben tests his nerves on the Dragonfly Tower, a 52-meter-high attraction featuring one of Europe’s tallest waterslides.

records.headline: Actress Hayden Panettiere dies at 36
records.summary: Hayden Panettiere, known for her roles in hit series “Heroes” and musical drama “Nashville,” has died at 36, her representative says.

records.headline: Deadliest Ebola outbreak in D.R. Congo history
records.summary: The latest Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo has killed 2,325 people, according to government data. That surpasses the toll from the 2018-2020 outbreak to become the deadliest in the country’s history.

records.headline: Former Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism found dead
records.summary: Jason Arday, a former University of Cambridge professor, was found dead in London on Friday, just days after resigning over questions surrounding his career.

records.headline: Influencer explains why he promotes steroids
records.summary: Fitness influencer Ryan Johnson use his mantra "Tan. Jacked. Handsome" to promote testosterone use to his followers. CNN's Isobel Yeung gets a look at how he earns thousands of dollars a month to help other men transform their bodies. Watch the full report on The Whole Story with Anderson Cooper -- “Stacked: Inside the Enhancement Craze,” airing Sunday, August 16 at 8pm ET/PT.

records.headline: Blanche declines to pledge independence from White House
records.summary: United States Attorney General Todd Blanche said he’s “not going to pledge” complete independence from the White House during an interview with NBC’s “Meet the Press” on Sunday. It comes as the Justice Department has faced accusations of political dealing on the president’s behalf.

records.headline: Camera captures moment shots were fired in deadly Kentucky shooting
records.summary: A content creator was filming a community event in Lexington, Kentucky, on Saturday when he captured the gunfire that killed one person and injured four others.

records.headline: Even critics notice Botox ruining movies
records.summary: Actors are looking unusually refreshed and youthful onscreen. But uncanny beauty makes it harder to buy into a story. Let’s cut right to it.

records.headline: Teen charged with double murder used ChatGPT, officials say
records.summary: A 17-year-old teenager from Massachusetts who is accused of the double murder of his mom and younger brother allegedly used ChatGPT to search up “fantasy” stories related to killing his family, say prosecutors. Arjun Aravind has pleaded not guilty to two counts of murder and other charges. CNN reached out to OpenAI about the murder case. A probable cause hearing has been set for September 11.

records.headline: Section of highway in Hawaii destroyed after Hurricane Lala
records.summary: Drone footage captured the destructive aftermath of Hurricane Lala on a section of Highway 11 in Pāhala, Hawaii, effectively cutting off the southern portion of the island.

records.headline: Jon Ossoff takes aim at Trump with he 'sleeps through his meetings' jab
records.summary: Democratic Sen. Jon Ossoff fired up the crowd by going after President Donald Trump during a rally in Atlanta, Georgia, yesterday, as part of his bid for reelection in November. Among his attacks were claims that Trump "sleeps through his meetings" and "trades stocks" while US servicemen and women fight his wars. Ossoff also criticized the new Qatar-gifted Air Force

records.headline: Jinny Lu named 'World's Ugliest Dog'
records.summary: A 6-year-old pug named Jinny Lu earned the top spot in the World’s Ugliest Dog Contest organized in Santa Rosa, California. The competition, in its 50th edition this year, aims to advocate pet adoption and celebrate beauty in all forms.

records.headline: How an agent completely misread the talent of this Oscar winner
records.summary: Early in Allison Janney's career an agent told her she'd only be able to play two types of roles -- and you'll never believe what they were.Join CNN’s Elizabeth Wagmeister as she interviews Emmy-nominated celebrities on anything from their career-defining moments to news-making reflections. Stream episodes of Coming Up on the CNN app now.

records.headline: Workers find $10 million in gold under former brewery
records.summary: Construction workers uncovered gold estimated to be worth more than $10 million when renovating a building at the site of a former brewery in Dendermonde, Belgium.

records.headline: GOP senator calls Trump's vaccine change 'potentially tragic'
records.summary: Republican Sen. Bill Cassidy slammed President Donald Trump’s executive order last week that makes recommendations about the childhood vaccine schedule and says that the measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) vaccine should be split into three separate shots, calling the action "potentially tragic."

records.headline: Ecuadorian boats were allegedly attacked with bomb-dropping drones
records.summary: CNN spoke to fishermen on board two different Ecuadorian fishing boats who say their vessels were sunk in unexplained attacks involving small, explosive-laden rotor drones launched by armed foreigners in March.

records.headline: Why Trump is scaling back ongoing US-South Korea military drills
records.summary: President Donald Trump announced that the US would reduce military exercises with its key ally South Korea, just hours before drills were due to start. In his Truth Social post, Trump cited his positive relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un and Seoul’s lack of assistance with Iran. CNN's Will Ripley reports.

records.headline: Capsized ferry leaves over 70 dead in Zimbabwe
records.summary: Eighteen children were among more than 70 people killed when an overloaded ferry capsized on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe this week. That’s according to police over the weekend after rescuers recovered more bodies.

records.headline: Indiana library devastated by flood
records.summary: A public library in Yorktown, Indiana was devastated by flooding after drenching storms rolled over the already flood-ravaged Midwest.
